newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia raises farmgate price of unhusked rice.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia raises farmgate price of unhusked rice.

text.p: Indonesia has raised the farmgate rice price by 16.67 percent to 525 rupiah per kg from 450 rupiah with immediate effect, the head of the state logistics agency BULOG said on Friday.

"We want to increase our farmers' income. The government has decided to raise to 525 rupiah/kg from 400 rupiah the purchase price of cooperatives from farmers," Beddu Amang told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
He said the increase would not have a significant impact on inflation. "It will contribute an annual 1.09 percent increase to inflation," Amang said.
He said the government also raised urea fertiliser price to 400 rupiah/kg from 330 rupiah.
